text:
Aisha (CS): FYI opened an internal thread after Acme reported failing generation calls. embeddings and rerank succeed but /generate returns 403. ticket: #CS-8421

Aisha (CS): Root repro from customer: they POST to /v1/generate and get 403. they've tried rotating the key once, no change.

Aisha (CS): CURL they ran:
```
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rw-medium-1","input":"hello"}'
```

Aisha (CS): Error body they receive (audit logs show same):
```json
{"error":{"type":"insufficient_scope","message":"missing scope:generation"}}
```

Mike (Support): Checked audit & auth logs. The service key was created by our SSO provisioning flow (provisioning-bot). The key metadata shows scopes: ["embeddings","rerank"]. No generation/inference scope present.

Mike (Support): Quick notes: customer says they used the product UI to request a service key for 'inference + embeddings + rerank' during onboarding. Something in the SSO pipeline looks like it dropped generation scope.

Jane (Eng): Can you paste the provisioning event id? I'll check the rotation hooks and the scope-mapping code. Also need the customer org id.

Aisha (CS): Org: acme-corp-42, provisioning event id: prov_evt_20240412_777a

Mike (Support): From audit event (redacted):
```
provisioning-bot created service_key id=sk_abc123 for org=acme-corp-42
metadata.scopes = ["embeddings","rerank"]
user_requested = ["generation","embeddings","rerank"]
```

Mike (Support): Looks like requested scopes differ from assigned scopes. Suspect the rotation/renewal path that runs right after creation.

Jane (Eng): I pulled the rotation-job logs. There's a post-create hook that re-serializes scopes from the SSO assertion. In this customer’s SAML assertion the attribute was named "allowed_features", which maps to feature keys. New mapping code has a bug that maps "inference" -> "inference" but our enforcement expects the scope named "generation". If mapping fails we drop that scope.

Jane (Eng): Repro steps I ran locally: simulate provisioning with SAML attributes missing the alias. It results in assigned scopes: embeddings, rerank. Generation absent => 403 on /generate, 200 on /embeddings and rerank endpoints.

Jane (Eng): Local repro commands:
```bash
# simulate the SSO assertion payload
python tools/sim_provision.py --org acme-corp-42 --attrs '{"allowed_features":["embeddings","rerank"]}'
# check assigned scopes
jq '.metadata.scopes' artifacts/sk_abc123.json
```

Aisha (CS): Customer workaround: create a new API key manually in Console (Admin > API keys) and explicitly check the "Generation / Inference" permission. They tested this and generation works immediately. But they need automatic provisioning for thousands of service keys so manual isn't acceptable long-term.

Mike (Support): Short-term action for CS: advise Acme to use manual key creation for production until we fix. I've provided steps and linked to the Console screenshots. Also added a temporary support flag to allow their CI to use the manually-created key.

Jane (Eng): Longer-term fix: change mapping in provisioning service to accept both aliases ("generation" and "inference") and add a test that asserts requested scopes are preserved after rotation/renewal. I opened a PR: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/prov/merge_requests/489 (tests + migration).

provisioning-bot: Scheduled job prov-fix-489 to run integration tests in staging at 2024-04-13T05:00Z.

Jane (Eng): I'll also add an audit alert that flags when requested_scopes != assigned_scopes with severity=high and auto-creates a CS ticket. That should catch regressions.

Mike (Support): Follow-up items captured: 
- [ ] CS: notify customer and confirm manual key works (Aisha)
- [ ] Eng: deploy mapping fix + tests to staging (Jane)
- [ ] Eng: create audit alert and run migration to normalize previous keys (Jane)
- [ ] Support: backfill any orgs with mismatched scopes and open outreach (Mike)

Aisha (CS): Customer update (sent): "We verified a manually created key with Generation permission works. We will use that while Redwood patches the provisioning flow. Please keep us posted on timeline." :thumbsup:

Mike (Support): ETA from Jane for staging deploy ~ 24hrs, prod ~48-72hrs after verification. I'll keep ticket #CS-8421 updated.

Jane (Eng): I'll post back here when staging test completes. If anyone from Security wants eyes on the audit migration, ping me.

Aisha (CS): Thanks team. I'll close the loop with the customer and mark the incident as 'mitigated, workaround available'.

Mike (Support): Adding note to incident log: root cause = provisioning mapping bug dropped 'generation' scope; mitigation = manual key creation; fix = mapping update + tests + audit alert.

Jane (Eng): Staging tests passed (prov-fix-489) — next step: canary to 10% of orgs tomorrow. Will update once canary finished.

Aisha (CS): Closing thread once canary is in prod or customer confirms prod key switch.
